grammarFocus: to do 表目的；动词后接 to do / doing 的常见用法；基础被动语态入门。
title: Smart Home Helpers: A Conversation About Everyday Tech
instructions: 这是一份模拟听力练习，主题为科技与日常工具。请先听录音（或阅读录音文本），然后回答10个问题。问题类型包括单选、填空和判断正误/未提及。填空答案必须与原文完全一致，且不超过字数限制。所有解释均为中文，并附有原文证据。
transcript:
Mia: Hi, Leo! You look tired. Are you okay?
Leo: Yeah, I'm fine. I just spent an hour trying to set up my new smart speaker. It's supposed to make life easier, but it's driving me crazy.
Mia: Oh no! What's the problem?
Leo: Well, I want to use it to play music and check the weather. But I can't get it to connect to my Wi-Fi.
Mia: Did you read the instructions?
Leo: Of course I did! But they're not very clear. It says to press the button for five seconds, but nothing happens.
Mia: Hmm. Maybe you need to hold it longer? My brother has one, and he said you have to hold it until the light turns blue.
Leo: Oh, really? Let me try that. ... Okay, it's working now! Thanks!
Mia: No problem. So, what else can it do?
Leo: It can set alarms, read the news, and even order pizza. But I mainly use it for music.
Mia: That's cool. I'm thinking about getting a smart plug. You can use it to turn off appliances remotely.
Leo: That sounds useful. But aren't you worried about privacy? I heard these devices are always listening.
Mia: Well, you can turn off the microphone when you're not using it. And the data is supposed to be kept safe.
Leo: I guess so. But I still prefer to do things manually. I don't like relying on technology too much.
Mia: I understand. But for me, these tools are designed to save time. I can use the extra time to relax.
Leo: That's a good point. Maybe I'll get used to it. Anyway, I need to go now. See you!
Mia: See you! Good luck with your smart speaker!

grammar.title: to do 表目的；动词后接 to do / doing；基础被动语态
grammar.explanation: 在英语中，'to do' 可以表示目的，例如 'I want to use it to play music' 中 'to play music' 表示目的。有些动词后面接 'to do'，如 'want to do', 'try to do', 'need to do'；有些动词后面接 'doing'，如 'enjoy doing', 'finish doing'。基础被动语态由 'be + 过去分词' 构成，表示被动，例如 'the data is kept safe'。
grammar.example: I want to use it to play music and check the weather.

questions.explanation: want 后面接 to do，表示想要做某事，因此选 to buy。
questions.evidence: She wants to buy a new phone.

questions.prompt: He enjoys ______ music in the evening.
questions.explanation: enjoy 后面接 doing，表示喜欢做某事，因此选 listening。
questions.evidence: He enjoys listening to music in the evening.

questions.prompt: The cake ______ by my mother yesterday.
questions.explanation: 蛋糕是被做的，用被动语态 was made（过去时）。
questions.evidence: The cake was made by my mother yesterday.

questions.prompt: I use my phone ______ with my friends.
questions.explanation: 这里 to talk 表示目的，即用手机是为了和朋友交谈。
questions.evidence: I use my phone to talk with my friends.
